entities.summary: Universitas YARSI is a private Islamic university located in Cempaka Putih, Central Jakarta. It was established on 15 April 1967 as Perguruan Tinggi Kedokteran YARSI. Originally founded to address the shortage of medical professionals among the Muslim community in Indonesia, the university has since evolved into a comprehensive institution offering a diverse range of academic programs across multiple disciplines. Universitas YARSI is a pioneer and the trailblazer in Islamic medical programs in Indonesian higher education.
